# Congro;Library

> Congro;Library is a modular C11 library for portable systems programming,
> education, experimentation, and reusable low-level components.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/samucaoo1/Congro-Library

- Algorithm
- Cast
- Error

- Bit
- Chronometry

- Math
- Network
- Random
- Struct
- Text
- Type

## Architectural facts

- Language baseline: C11.
- Header-oriented / single-header-style organization.
- .impl files are implementation pages included by headers; they are not separately linked translation units.
- .space files hold namespace/package configuration and common declarations.
- OPSTATUS is used for operational failure reporting.
- Public APIs aim to remain portable; OS-native details belong in backends or explicit native escape hatches.
- Selected APIs can expose optional pseudo-method/vtable ergonomics while concrete functions remain fundamental.
- The project follows a zero-link philosophy where viable: avoid mandatory user linker flags such as -lm, -pthread, or -lws2_32 when the implementation can remain self-contained.

## Status

Experimental and under active development. APIs may change.

containers; generic data structures; concurrency; threads; coroutines; networking;
sockets; Unicode; UTF-8; UTF-16; text grid; random number generation; mathematics;
memory management; C preprocessor metaprogramming; educational C library.
